response.query: Which capture–recapture dependence-structure sensitivity analyses (eg latent-class, Bayesian) should be performed and what fit/heterogeneity thresholds will indicate acceptable estimates?
response.answer: Perform latent-class and Bayesian capture–recapture analyses; acceptable fit/heterogeneity thresholds are typically AICc < 2 and low DIC values.
